units.rawText: Back then, Betty and Tinny were wandering the Cloud. We had no food, nothing to drink... we were even chased down by the Sanctifiers... Betty was dazzled, nya.

units.rawText: Then Master showed up, nya! Master adopted Betty, gave Betty food, new clothes, and a warm home, nya! Promise Betty you'll always find Betty, even if Betty gets lost, nya!
